row_level_protocol: fixed held-out workbook; distinct review IDs but 90/110 unique review texts overlap training
grouped_protocol: 3-fold GroupKFold on exact review_text; out-of-fold predictions only
notes: No dependencies are installed by this experiment.
Five aspect ratings are diagnostic-only due to simultaneous sub-target leakage.
review_id, customer_name, rating, and post-publication helpful_votes are excluded from valid predictor sets.
Raw high-cardinality price_local is excluded; price_usd is used instead.
Original D1 evaluation artifacts are read-only.
